output.brief: The Kestria buffering is not caused by the new CDN. It comes from smart-TV app 5.2. That release lowered the startup buffer from 10 s to 4 s, and Kestria was the canary market, with 100% rollout from 9 Oct, the same day the CDN cutover finished. Smart-TV 5.2 stalls 5.9% of viewing time on every ISP. Every other client on the same CDN and the same ISPs sits at 0.6–0.7%. Dogfood on Corvane showed the same fault (5.7% vs 0.6%) before launch. Handball demand and ISP congestion don't fit, because only one client type is affected. I'm quite sure of this. What to do next: (1) Revert Kestria to the 5.1 settings through the remote-config profile abr_v2. It takes about an hour and needs no new build. (2) Hold the 20 Nov all-market rollout until the regression is fixed. (3) Don't send the SLA notice, withhold fees or move traffic back to Corvane. (4) Don't mute the rebuffering alert. It is catching a real fault. (5) Check rebuffering and tickets after the revert. (6) Hold off on the win-back offer. The 1 October price rise also plausibly drove cancellations, and that link is unproven. (7) Add app-version and device breakdowns to the dashboard.
